description: Prime Location... Perfectly positioned in the heart of Studio City, this beautifully maintained ground-level condominium offers the ideal balance of comfort, convenience, and vibrant city living. Located just minutes from Universal Studios Hollywood and the charming neighborhood of Tujunga Village and Toluca Lake, the home sits in one of the most sought-after pockets of the San Fernando Valley, surrounded by major film studios, renowned schools, and some of the area's best shopping and dining destinations. Designed with both functionality and style in mind, the residence features an open and light-filled floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating an inviting space perfect for everyday living and entertaining.  Large windows allow natural light to pour in, enhancing the bright and airy atmosphere throughout the home. The condo offers 3 well-appointed bedrooms, providing comfort and flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. An oversized patio extends the living space outdoors, ideal for relaxing, dining al fresco, or enjoying Southern California's year-round climate. With move-in ready condition and an unbeatable central location, the property offers convenient access to the Westside, Downtown Los Angeles, and major freeways, making commuting and exploring the city effortless. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy Studio City living at its finest, where lifestyle, location, and comfort come together in one exceptional home.
